sampling: Preserve original 400 rows; random 20 per new source x combined-band stratum, or census if fewer than 20
source_attribution: First occurrence in unchanged S1,L1,S2,L2,... round robin, deduplicated by email ID
relevance_rubric: Broad investigative-topic relevance, applied identically across ranks and sources: 1 for substantive or indirect connections to SPEs, off-balance-sheet or structured financing, associated transactions/documents/participants, retained obligations or financial accounting/disclosure questions bearing on the investigation. Explicitly identified target-transaction document requests and administrative leads qualify. Neither a contradiction nor knowledge of wrongdoing is required. Generic trading contracts, routine customer credit/guarantees, unrelated market misconduct, social messages and generic Enron news without such a connection receive 0. Insufficient context is coded 0 with an uncertainty flag, not assumed relevant.
